definitions.explanation: Something to refer to or consult for information or guidance.

examples.japanese: ご{参考|さんこう}までに
{過去|かこ}の{事例|じれい}を{参考|さんこう}にしながら、{新|あたら}しい{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: We made a new plan while referring to past cases.

notes:
{参考|さんこう} means consulting information for guidance. It is used both as a noun and with する as a verb.

KEY PATTERNS:
- {参考|さんこう}にする: to use as reference, to take into account
- {参考|さんこう}になる: to be helpful, to be informative
- ご{参考|さんこう}までに: for your reference (polite, common in business)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {参考|さんこう}{書|しょ}: reference book
- {参考|さんこう}{文献|ぶんけん}: bibliography, references
- {参考|さんこう}{資料|しりょう}: reference materials
- {参考|さんこう}{価格|かかく}: reference price

REGISTER:
Wide usage from casual to formal. The polite prefix ご{参考|さんこう} is standard in business email and presentations.
